verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any human support channels (phone, email, live agent) or stated support response times for issues with a specific piece of mail. The only timing commitments are operational processing SLAs: scanning within 6 business hours and check deposits within 1 business day. Those are service turnaround times, not support response expectations. A 'contact us' note covers API access requests, not mail support, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an operator, I can reach a human about a specific piece of mail — real support channels with stated response expectations, because a lost check isn't a chatbot problem
